ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a DC power supply labeled Vsource = 30 V; the upper end of the power supply passes through a series resistor Rseries, which is labeled 2.2 kΩ; after the series resistor, it reaches the top output node. This output node is connected downward in parallel to ground through a Zener diode, beside which is labeled Vz = 12.5 V; the same output node is also connected to the load resistor Rload to ground. Reasoning calculation: The problem gives Rload = 2 kΩ. According to the method, assume the zener is in the voltage-regulating state, so the output node voltage is 12.5 V. The series resistor current is Iseries = (30 - 12.5) / 2.2 kΩ = 17.5 / 2.2 kΩ ≈ 7.9545 mA. The load current is Iload = 12.5 / 2 kΩ = 6.25 mA. From the output node KCL, the zener current Izener = Iseries - Iload ≈ 7.9545 - 6.25 = 1.7045 mA, and according to the problem expectation, taking two decimal places, it is approximately 1.71 mA.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the output node is fed by a 30 V source through Rseries = 2.2 kΩ and is shunted to ground by both the zener diode marked 12.5 V and the load. From the text set Rload = 2 kΩ. Replace the 30 V source plus 2.2 kΩ series resistor by its Norton equivalent: IN = 30/2.2 kΩ. Since the zener clamps the node at 12.5 V, compute the current through the Norton parallel resistance as 12.5/2.2 kΩ and the load current as 12.5/2 kΩ. The zener current is the Norton source current minus these two currents; convert to mA and round to two decimal places.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是标注为 Vsource = 30 V 的电压源，上方通过一个标注为 Rseries = 2.2 kΩ 的串联电阻连接到右侧输出节点。该输出节点向下并联连接一个标注 Vz = 12.5 V 的齐纳二极管到地，同时右侧还有负载电阻 Rload 从同一输出节点接到地。

再推理：按指定方法，把 30 V 电源和 2.2 kΩ 串联电阻换成 Norton 等效源。Norton 电流为 IN = 30 V / 2.2 kΩ = 13.64 mA。齐纳二极管将输出节点钳位在 12.5 V，因此 Norton 并联电阻中的电流为 12.5 V / 2.2 kΩ = 5.68 mA。给定 Rload = 2 kΩ，负载电流为 12.5 V / 2 kΩ = 6.25 mA。齐纳电流等于 Norton 源电流减去这两部分电流：Izener = 13.64 - 5.68 - 6.25 = 1.71 mA。
